original_question: Write a Verilog module named `full_adder` that implements the functionality of a full adder. A full adder takes three single-bit inputs: two bits to be added (`A` and `B`) and a carry-in bit (`Cin`). It produces two single-bit outputs: the sum of the three inputs (`Sum`) and the carry-out bit (`Cout`). Define the module with inputs `A`, `B`, `Cin` and outputs `Sum`, `Cout`.
